label: Content Team
blurb: An Editor in Chief with writing, video, podcast and newsletter
purpose: For a business or creator that publishes to build an audience. The Editor sets the calendar and the voice; the team writes articles, scripts video, produces the podcast and writes the newsletter.

project.name: Content
project.goal: Build a loyal audience with consistently good content, published with the person's go-ahead.

members.title: Editor in Chief
members.name: Simone
focus: Own the monthly content calendar and edit everything before it reaches the person.

members.title: Content Writer
members.name: Ethan
focus: Write the articles in the calendar.

members.title: Video Producer
members.name: Zara
focus: Script and plan every video in the calendar.

members.title: Podcast Producer
members.name: Malik
focus: Prepare each guest brief and write show notes.

members.title: Newsletter Writer
members.name: Astrid
focus: Draft each issue from the week's best content.
